step_matches.reason: In both maps the requesting department nominates the cardholder.
In both maps the cardholder completes initial training.
In both maps the appointing authority (HA) appoints the cardholder on SF 1402.
The AI has no step suspending an account for missing refresher training; its S96 suspension is a PMR stand-down action.
In both maps N8 assigns the LOA to process the purchase request.
In both maps the requestor completes the documentation, obtains signatures and provides signed copies to N8 and the CH.
In both maps N8 uses funds status from the Corporate Master Execution File.
In both maps the N8 funds manager forwards requirements to the Comptroller for review.
In both maps N8 asks Division Directors/Special Assistants for unfunded requirements at fiscal year end.
In both maps the CH ensures the R/FM has committed funds before purchasing.
In both maps the CH screens the purchase against mandatory sources.
In both maps the CH obtains AO approval before purchasing.
In both maps the CH confirms the merchant's billing, back-order, delivery and packing list terms.
AI S37 includes reminding the merchant not to charge sales tax.
The AI has no step in which the cardholder certifies quality and quantity; its inspection step S42 uses a different actor.
The AI merged FOB destination into S37, which is already matched to S14.
In both maps the CH records the transaction in the purchase card log with supporting documentation.
In both maps the CH uses pay-and-confirm for items billed but not received.
In both maps the CH certifies the bank statement and forwards documentation to the AO/CO.
In both maps the AO reviews the absent CH's statement and certifies the account for payment.
In both maps the CH attaches an explanation for undocumented transactions.
In both maps the AO/CO certifies the monthly invoice.
In both maps the AO/CO notifies the A/OPC or NETC N4 of a suspected unauthorized purchase.
In both maps the AO completes the PAT review and returns documentation to the CH.
In both maps the CH or AO contacts the A/OPC about a suspect transaction.
In both maps the CH disputes the transaction in CitiDirect.
In both maps the dispute form is faxed or mailed to CITIBANK.
In both maps the dispute is tracked to resolution.
In both maps the charge is offset with a credit.
In both maps CITIBANK sends a letter and the charge is rebilled on the next invoice.
In both maps the A/OPC is notified of suspected fraud.
In both maps the A/OPC contacts CITIBANK about the fraud.
In both maps CITIBANK closes the account, issues a replacement and moves valid transactions.
AI S74 assigns the short-pay to the AO/CO rather than the cardholder, so the actor differs.
In both maps the CH submits the Declaration of Unauthorized Use form to the bank.
In both maps the CH reports the lost or stolen card to CITIBANK.
In both maps the CH notifies the AO and the A/OPC.
In both maps the AO submits a written report to the A/OPC.
In both maps CITIBANK mails a replacement card.
In both maps the CH cuts the found card in half and turns it in.
In both maps the A/OPC makes the departing CH's account inactive.
In both maps the A/OPC reduces the limits to $1 and cuts up the card.
In both maps the A/OPC closes the account once everything has cleared.
In both maps the CH turns in the transaction files to the AO/CO.

decision_matches.reason: The micro-purchase threshold condition is the same, and Yes leads to the SF 1402 appointment in both maps.
The AI has no decision on appointment revocation or employee separation.
The AI has no decision on whether training requirements are met.
The condition matches, but the AI's No branch skips the funds status step and goes straight to the CH purchase.
The exhausted branch matches, but the AI's funds-available branch goes to LOA assignment instead of the fiscal-year-end request.
The condition matches, but the AI's Yes branch leads to AO approval rather than confirming merchant terms.
The billed-not-received condition is the same, with Yes leading to pay-and-confirm and No to certifying the statement.
The CH-availability condition is the same, with No routing toward AO certification and Yes toward CH review.
The condition is the same in inverted form: missing documentation leads to the explanation step, otherwise certification proceeds.
The dispute-resolution condition and both outcomes (offset credit vs. letter and rebill) match.
The AI decides fraud vs. dispute before contacting CITIBANK, and its No branch leads to the dispute procedure rather than END.
The card-found condition and both outcomes match.
The AI has no explicit decision on whether the cardholder is leaving the command.
The outstanding-transactions condition and both outcomes ($1 limit vs. close account) match.
